name: Our Light Affliction: Spider's Covenant
source:
Every diviner knows that getting involved with creatures from the beyond can lead to nothing but disaster. But when the only way to save her best friend is getting into a contract with a spider apparition, what choice does Edelweiss have? As Edelweiss helps Lucifrid take control of the dark side of her school, they draw the attention of exorcist Ilya, who is determined to destroy Lucifrid and set Edelweiss free.

Help Edelweiss navigate this tangled web and choose between agency or surrender, loving or letting go. But beware, no choice comes without sacrifice...

[From [url=https://nefferinthia.itch.io/our-light-affliction-spiders-covenant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每个占卜师都知道，与来自彼岸的生物打交道只会带来灾难。但当拯救她最好的朋友的唯一方法就是与蜘蛛幽灵签订契约时，雪绒花有什么选择呢？当雪绒花帮助路西芙丽控制学校的黑暗面时，他们引起了驱魔师伊利亚的注意，伊利亚决心摧毁路西芙丽并释放雪绒花。

帮助雪绒花浏览这个错综复杂的网络，并在代理或投降、爱或放手之间做出选择。但要注意，没有牺牲就没有选择……

[来自[url=https://nefferinthia.itch.io/our-light-affliction-spiders-covenant]itch.io[/url]]
